def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    threshold = case['utility_threshold']
    node_dict = {node['id']: node for node in nodes}
    # Build children mapping
    children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        children[node['id']] = []
    for node in nodes:
        p = node['parent']
        if p is not None:
            children[p].append(node['id'])
    # Initial queue
    # depth descending, then stable node-ID order (alphabetical)
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    queue = [n['id'] for n in sorted_nodes]
    retained = set(node['id'] for node in nodes)
    visit_order = []
    while queue:
        nid = queue.pop(0)  # O(n) but fine for small
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        # Check leaf: no child in retained
        is_leaf = True
        for child in children[nid]:
            if child in retained:
                is_leaf = False
                break
        visit_order.append(nid)
        if is_leaf and node_dict[nid]['removable'] and node_dict[nid]['utility'] <= threshold:
            # Remove leaf
            retained.remove(nid)
            # Enqueue parent if retained
            parent = node_dict[nid]['parent']
            if parent is not None and parent in retained:
                queue.append(parent)
    # Build retained_node_ids: maybe in original order or sorted. Use order of original nodes list.
    retained_node_ids = [node['id'] for node in nodes if node['id'] in retained]
    return {"retained_node_ids": retained_node_ids, "visit_order": visit_order}
